reasons.1: The painted blue, ivory and brass materials, clear planes and elevated full-body presentation closely match the master.
reasons.2: Right-hand rod, left-hip satchel, one diagonal harness, one waist belt, paired bracers and buckled boots persist; the jaw is sharper and ponytail fuller, with minor fastening and hem drift.
reasons.3: Screen-left hair, shoulder and rod-cap highlights support an upper-left key, although the ambient fill is more neutral and warm than the registered deep cool treatment.
reasons.4: The isolated rod cap, projecting face and high ponytail give a strong SW silhouette against the supplied small-scale anchor.
reasons.5: Smooth painted skin, restrained cloth texture and softly modeled leather closely preserve the master's brush register.

reasons.1: The left profile retains the master's painted material hierarchy, palette and clean full-body contours.
reasons.2: The near anatomical right hand holds the rod and the left-hip bag is mostly occluded; one harness and waist belt remain, with a taller ponytail and altered tunic-panel lengths.
reasons.3: Upper-left highlights on the hair, face and rod cap remain screen-fixed; the broad warm sleeve fill weakens the prescribed cool ambient contrast.
reasons.4: The nose and rear ponytail clearly establish W, while the rod remains separate but its small plain cap has limited prominence at 64 px.
reasons.5: Hair strands, cloth folds and leather edges use the same controlled painted detail and soft transitions as the master.

reasons.1: Materials and palette match, but the visible rightward cheek and right-pointing boots establish NE rather than the requested NW rotation.
reasons.2: For the visible NE anatomy, the rod is in the right hand and bag on the left hip, with one diagonal harness and one waist belt; longer hanging curls and rear-panel geometry drift, and this is a facing error rather than mirrored anatomy.
reasons.3: The left hair edge, left sleeve and rod-cap edge carry the strongest key highlights, consistent with upper-left light but relatively warm ambient fill.
reasons.4: The rod and ponytail are distinct and the back-three-quarter silhouette is readable, but its directional cues identify NE rather than NW.
reasons.5: The rear cloth, curls and leather retain the master's smooth illustrated finish without conspicuous brush grain.

reasons.1: The centered rear view preserves the blue, ivory and brass register, material readability and full-body presentation.
reasons.2: Rod on anatomical right and satchel on anatomical left are correct, with one right-shoulder-to-left-hip harness, one waist belt and paired bracers; the ponytail is denser and longer, while face and front fastenings are occluded.
reasons.3: Screen-left shoulder, sleeve and hair highlights support the fixed upper-left key, though shadows remain warmer and lighter than the registered cool ambient.
reasons.4: The centered back, separate right-side rod and compact hair mass provide a clear N read at the anchor's small scale.
reasons.5: Rear fabric folds, hair modeling and leather texture remain consistent with the master's polished painted treatment.

reasons.1: The rear-right rotation retains the master's palette, clean material planes and illustrated full-body register.
reasons.2: The rod remains in the right hand and bag on the left hip, with one diagonal harness and one waist belt; the lower strap has a more elaborate run of keepers and the curls extend farther down the back.
reasons.3: Left-edge hair and sleeve illumination and the rod-cap highlight support screen upper-left lighting, with less cool ambient separation than specified.
reasons.4: Rightward cheek and boot cues, a separated rod cap and the rear hair mass make NE readily distinguishable at small scale.
reasons.5: Controlled highlights, soft painted shading and restrained surface texture match the master's brush register.

reasons.1: The painted register and right profile match well, but the rod-bearing arm moves behind the torso instead of maintaining the master's forward hold.
reasons.2: The near left arm hangs free, the far right hand holds the rod and the bag remains on the left side; one harness and waist belt persist, although the bag shifts forward and the arm pose changes.
reasons.3: The upper-left hair and shoulder highlights and left edge of the rod cap support the fixed key, while broad warm fill reduces cool-shadow contrast.
reasons.4: The face clearly reads E, but the rod cap meets the lower hair mass and much of the shaft merges with the body at small scale.
reasons.5: The smooth face, modeled curls and subtle fabric and leather texture closely match the master's painted finish.

reasons.1: The visual register closely matches, but the broad frontal torso and near-frontal face remain closest to the approved S master, with insufficient SE rotation.
reasons.2: Face and hair identity are close, and the right-hand rod, left-hip bag, one harness, one belt, bracers and boots persist; a prominent brass harness fastening at the waist replaces the master's simpler leather junction.
reasons.3: Screen-left hair, collar, sleeve and rod-cap highlights retain the upper-left key, although skin and leather fill remain relatively warm.
reasons.4: The rod and hair are distinct, but the silhouette is too similar to S to communicate SE reliably at 64 px; the shallow rightward head turn is ambiguous.
reasons.5: The candidate closely preserves the master's smooth painted material transitions and restrained texture.

reasons.1: The left-facing figure retains the master's palette and painted material language, but reverses the asymmetric equipment arrangement and lighting.
reasons.2: Mirrored: in this W profile the near anatomical right arm hangs free with the satchel on that side, while the far anatomical left hand holds the rod; the single harness and belt remain but their sided arrangement is reversed.
reasons.3: The strongest hair and shoulder highlights and bright right edge of the rod cap indicate an upper-right key, contrary to the fixed upper-left requirement.
reasons.4: The face clearly reads W, but the rear rod cap crowds the hair and the shaft merges with the body, weakening independent rod recognition at 64 px.
reasons.5: Despite the anatomical reversal, the skin, curls, cloth and leather maintain the master's smooth painted brush register.
